prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1496; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver reporting a low-speed head-on collision at an intersection. Vehicle is drivable but front bumper, hood, and radiator support show damage. Claimant reports pain and swelling in the left wrist and has been advised to seek medical evaluation. Photos requested from the insured and scene diagram obtained.

Entry 2: Spoke with the other driver, who confirms the impact was minor but reports neck stiffness and a wrist injury after bracing against the steering wheel. Claimant states they are not represented by an attorney and prefers to handle the claim directly. Explained the claims process, coverage review, and the right to obtain independent medical care. Noted the claimant's preference for written correspondence.

Entry 3: Received urgent care records showing an X-ray of the left wrist with a fracture of the distal radius. Treatment includes a splint, pain management, and orthopedic follow-up. Claimant reports missed work for several days and is asking about how wage loss is handled. Advised that documentation of lost time will be needed and provided the required forms.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspected at the repair facility. Damage is consistent with the reported low-speed impact, with no airbag deployment and no frame involvement. Estimate prepared and submitted for review. Claimant asked whether a rental vehicle is covered and was informed of the rental provisions under the policy.

Entry 5: Followed up with the claimant regarding the orthopedic consult and rehabilitation plan. Claimant is progressing and expects to return to regular duties after the follow-up visit. Medical records requested with the claimant's signed authorization. File remains open pending receipt of records, the repair invoice, and wage documentation.
